author: Developer Agent
scope: Author visual review of first overworld sample plus existing home regression, not independent approval or whole-map acceptance

observations.standard: Full scene is unchanged relative to baseline at the same time and window. Exact equality separately proven by reader.
observations.low: Door facade/porch, home exit floor, skeleton silhouette and stone remain distinct at both sizes, including night. Reduced blue darkness; world art and silhouette are preserved.
observations.off: World darkness disappears while the actual clock and moon HUD remain at night. This is an effect switch.
observations.hud: Readable parchment HUD remains in identical positions and colors; opaque pixels checked separately.
observations.viewport: Changing the street owner leaves the home viewport unchanged; changing home leaves street unchanged; both restore exactly.

limitations: QA skeleton and stone are existing production entities held at a fixed pose; placement is an observation fixture, not a new gameplay encounter.
Existing art and house interior were not redesigned or accepted as new content.
Full-map composition, object-local light and roof occlusion remain outside VLIGHT-010.
Still frames do not accept live movement, Retina, long sessions, GPU or hardware FPS.
